The Butcher.Start Text: That stair was open a week ago. Then the Minotaur came up from the lower passages and claimed the corridor before it. Patrols reached the second level before; now no patrol, rescue party, or explorer can go deeper. Kill the Butcher and I will give you the keys carried by the last people who tried.
The Butcher.End Text: The stair is open again. That does not make it safe. Take the keys. Their last owners will not need them.
The Butcher.Help Text: If you are having trouble finding the Minotaur, he is located north of the entrance to the town.

Rat Trap.Start Text: Darn pesky rats keep getting into my food supply and I'd bet anything they come up from that dungeon. Help my out by killing as many as you need to collect 6 tails and I'll pay you 600 gold.
Rat Trap.End Text: Good riddance to the bastards, hopefully this will keep my food supplies in good order. Here's the gold I promised you.
Rat Trap.Help Text: Search the area around town on the first floor of the dungeon for those pesky little rat vermin.

Knock Back a Couple Brewskis.Start Text: My stock of beer is running low and my supplier says the reason is a shortage of the hops used to make it. The previous owner of the tavern once told me about a form of hops that could be found within the depths. He claimed it makes the most delicious drink you've ever tasted. If you could get me a few of them, I'll make sure you are the first to try it once it's done brewing. I'll also throw in some gold for your troubles.
Knock Back a Couple Brewskis.End Text: I don't believe it, I was sure the old coot was out of his mind with that tale but you found them! Come back later and I'll save you a glass. Also here's some gold for your troubles.
Knock Back a Couple Brewskis.Help Text: Hops can be found growing on certain types of flowering plants. I am not sure how many plants you'll find down there...

A Bad Dream.Start Text: Caedmon has the slip. Joffrey took chalk and enough oil for one lamp. If you cross his trail, will you see whether he reached the patrol?
A Bad Dream.End Text: My pendant...Elysia take me...he left me these keys last I saw of him...please avenge my love...(the waitress runs out sobbing...)
A Bad Dream.Help Text: An adventurer came in earlier. He said he saw Joffrey on the second floor of the dungeon. Joffrey had just unlocked a door in the northeast corner.

Where's the Beef?.Start Text: My wedding day is fast approaching and we are trying to save a few gold, so I am cooking the meal for the guests. If you could bring me back 12 pieces of mystery meat, I can reward you with this potion I received as a tip once.
Where's the Beef?.End Text: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You have made my special day that much easier. Please take this as a token of my appreciation.
Where's the Beef?.Help Text: The wedding guests aren't picky when it comes to the food, so any animal meat will do.

No Laughing Matter.Start Text: During my first week of training, a senior officer told us a story about a former recruit who went mad. He was a bit of an outcast and many of the other soldiers bullied him for his weirdness, as it was told. He had a fondness for card tricks and claimed he was an 'Agent of Chaos', whatever that means...anyway, he finally cracked one day and disappeared, never to be heard from again...that is until we started receiving the body parts...the freak has been sending back parts of adventurers with notes talking about revenge and signed by the Jester. Someone needs to take this sick bastard out before anyone else gets hurt. Be careful, you never truly know what you may get with this guy.
No Laughing Matter.End Text: Excellent work! Hopefully the souls of those tortured by the Jester will be able to rest now. This magical ring was shipped back with one of the body parts, it increases your chance to evade attacks in combat. I'm sure the Jester thought he was being clever, since it took so long for someone to finally catch him. It's fitting that you would wear it now.
No Laughing Matter.Help Text: The Jester has a bag full of tricks. Word is he even has the ability to change his resistances each round to keep you on your toes.

Metalingus.Start Text: The city guard are in desperate need of new equipment but we unfortunately are running short on the required materials. If you can bring back 8 pieces of scrap metal, I can use my connections with the alchemist shop and get you a really nice potion for your troubles.
Metalingus.End Text: You are a life saver, literally. This metal will help to fortify the town against the scum that patrols the dungeon. Take one of these potions as a token of my appreciation.
Metalingus.Help Text: There are a few sources of metal that would be usable, including broken equipment, metal constructs, and enemies that consume items.

Lapidation.Start Text: Rutger shoved this necklace over my head so hard the clasp cut me. I turned round to give it back. He was still reaching for me, and his fingers were stone. If you find that bird on the third floor, kill it.
Lapidation.End Text: Pell gives you the necklace Rutger put around his neck.
Lapidation.Help Text: Rutger and I were on the 3rd floor of the dungeon when we encountered the Cockatrice. Make sure you prepare for the powerful enemies on your way.

Hotter Than Hades.Start Text: Water tonight. Tomorrow you can ask me again. There's a reason I wanted a clear head: a bearer came in with three sets of tooth marks on his shield. Cerberus is still walking that same strip of floor. If you're going that deep, you'll have to get past him.
Hotter Than Hades.End Text: All those years on watch. I keep wondering who was supposed to come after him. Sit down a minute, will you?
Hotter Than Hades.Help Text: Cerberus is no joke. Obviously fire is a no go but I'd imagine dispel is also very useful. Hit 'em hard and hit 'em fast.

Ticket to Ride.Start Text: Hey, HEY, you! Can you...help me (hic)? I swear I had my ticket for the ra..raff...raffle in my left...no right pocket but it's no..(hic) nowhere to be found. I must have d...DROPPED it when I went down into the dungeon. It should be (hic) close to the stairs, I didn't go too far. Please find it for ME!
Ticket to Ride.End Text: That's it! Ah man...(hic), oh shoot, I didn't win...DAMN!!! Well...(hic) thanks anyways...OH yeah here's something for the ef..effort.
Ticket to Ride.Help Text: They've got to be somewhere around here...WHERE IS IT!!!

I'm Molting!.Start Text: SNAKES! Oh my I hate those things... (hic) ...slithering about. It's unnatural...I think... (hic)...what was I saying?...Oh yeah, bring me some snake skins and I'll give you these poison curing thingies I found... (hic)
I'm Molting!.End Text: WHY WOULD YOU BRING...oh yeah I asked you to... (hic) ..thanks I guess. Here's those things...ANTIDOTES, that's what they're called. BARKEEP, another beer please... (hic).
I'm Molting!.Help Text: Watch out for the snake's venom, as it can drain your health quickly.

Payback.Start Text: A wizard has been asking about the Pseudodragon. She wants a familiar. I've seen what becomes of the ones she takes. If you mean to face the creature, reach it before she does.
Payback.End Text: You won't have to meet that creature at the end of her leash. Here is what I promised.
Payback.Help Text: Do not mistake the Pseudodragon's miniature size, for its power is very potent. Beware of the deadly Fireball spell, as it can be devastating.

Dracarys.Start Text: The depths are guarded by a powerful Red Dragon. Treat the encounter as a barrier, not a trophy; draconic power leaves echoes in more than one shape. If you can survive her, the path below will open.
Dracarys.End Text: You have passed the dragon's trial and proven you can stand before power without mistaking it for certainty. Take this ring. It is not awake; each path must learn how to rouse it in its own way. Pursue the depths with care.
Dracarys.Help Text: The Red Dragon is your toughest test yet, with access to some of the strongest abilities. Defeating the boss opens the path to the 6th floor. Some class paths may reveal separate truths in the aftermath, but the progression victory is complete for every hero.

Pandora's Box.Start Text: Oh impressive, you have obtained the powerful Photon Sphere spell. Interested in making it more powerful? Of course you are, who wouldn't? Bring me the soul of a Lich and I will create an item on a scale hitherto undreamt of.
Pandora's Box.End Text: What a wonderful specimen you have brought me, this will do well in the ritual...oh right, here's that item I promised you.
Pandora's Box.Help Text: A Lich is a powerful foe, do not underestimate them!

Eight Is Enough.Start Text: The thieves guild has placed an order for several sets of leather armor but my supply of materials is getting short at the moment. Say, you look capable enough, do you think you could retrieve some for me? I'll pay top dollar for them.
Eight Is Enough.End Text: I knew it when I first saw you that you were the person for the job. As promised here's some gold for your efforts.
Eight Is Enough.Help Text: I am able to fashion leather armor out of either fresh animal hides or by using scraps from old armor pieces.

This Thing's Nuclear.Start Text: I came across an old dusty tome while cleaning out the belongings of my mentor. Most of it contained random armor designs but there was a loose piece of parchment that contained a blueprint for a way to increase a person's defensive prowess, however it requires some hard to find items. The hardest to come by is a nuclear power core, which sounds fake and may actually be, who knows? If by some miracle you find one, bring it to me and you will reap the benefit.
This Thing's Nuclear.End Text: So a power core is the secret to creating golems? This bit of information may prove to be more valuable than any thing I could give you. I do have an idea though. There may be a way to harness the power into you. If you're up for it of course. Step into the back and we will start the process.
This Thing's Nuclear.Help Text: I met an old wizard at the tavern who mentioned that power cores do indeed exist. I don't know how he knows this but he seems pretty credible. Maybe they are used to power something of incredible size?

He Ain't Heavy.Start Text: I am so glad you stopped in, I really need your help. My baby brother, Chisolm, has been missing for far too long. He regularly goes into the dungeon but never for this long. Please help me find him and I will forever be indebted to you.
He Ain't Heavy.End Text: By the light of Elysia, you have found him! I must admit I had given up hope. It comes at no surprise that he chose to stay in the depths to help those in need, perhaps he will choose to come home once the primal evil has been vanquished. As a reward, take this key—Chisolm told me of a vault deep below where legendary ore is kept. This key will grant you access.
He Ain't Heavy.Help Text: I haven't the faintest idea where Chisolm may be but he is a strong warrior and I have no doubt he is still alive. I have heard rumors of secret passageways in the depths but they have never been confirmed.

Put A Feather In It.Start Text: As you may or may not know, all of my tinctures are created here in my lab. I need some more ingredients to make more Phoenix Down potions, so any Feathers that you find I will pay you for them.
Put A Feather In It.End Text: Excellent! Here's the gold I promised, spend it wisely.
Put A Feather In It.Help Text: Birds have feathers, so try killing some birds. You may also find them on other enemies, as bird is a favorite dish to eat.

Naivete.Start Text: An adventurer brought me this magical potion the other day, asking me to make more for them. He offered to pay me a small fortune, as these Elixirs are very powerful and very rare. Unfortunately I need some pure spring water, as the water here in town is much too polluted. Take this empty vial and fill it with some if you happen to come across one and I will give you any extras I make.
Naivete.End Text: Hmmm...how do I know that this isn't regular water...well for one, it's not dark brown! I honestly wasn't even sure if there was a spring in the dungeon or if the water was as pure as needed. Give me just a sec, this won't take long.....................................................................that about does it. Here you go, thanks for your help!
Naivete.Help Text: I've heard that the spring is somewhere on the 3rd floor but I cannot confirm that.

Earth, Wind, and Fire...and Water and....Start Text: Long before I owned this shop, I was apprentice to a master craftsman. He taught me how to make a very powerful item called an Elemental Amulet, which requires the core of 6 elementals. However I have never been able to make this item since I was never able to obtain the components. Bring me the 6 Elemental Motes and the pendant will be yours.
Earth, Wind, and Fire...and Water and....End Text: Absolutely amazing, I doubted if I would ever be able to put this skill to the test. Please wait a moment while I place these motes into the amulet...here you go, I hope it serves you well!
Earth, Wind, and Fire...and Water and....Help Text: The elemental beasts known as Myrmidons come in many variations. Unfortunately the only way to know what type you are fighting is to see what elements work or don't work against them.

The Power of Elysia Compels You!.Start Text: We hung food in the passage to draw the Wendigo away from the spring. It ate the mule that brought the sacks. People still have to fetch water down there. Will you go?
The Power of Elysia Compels You!.End Text: They brought up the first full barrel this morning. Here. I set this aside for you.
The Power of Elysia Compels You!.Help Text: As with many creatures of the night, your best option for cleansing the world of the Wendigo is Fire. Stay away from using Ice magic.

The Shocker.Start Text: I need fat..no not for eating. We have many lamps throughout the church that require fuel and one of the primary sources is a special type of fat from a Golden Eagle. Three should be enough to last for quite some time. I can't offer you payment but I can offer you information that may be specifically interesting to you. I look forward to your return.
The Shocker.End Text: Excellent work! This will keep us going and help us continue to do our good work. Now for your reward...while I do not condone the art of witchcraft, we sometimes must ally with some less than savory characters to defeat a greater evil. Follow me...
The Shocker.Help Text: The Golden Eagle can be found on the third floor of the dungeon. Be careful of it piercing call, for it can deafen you.

investigate.Title: Investigate the patrol reports
investigate.Help Text: Follow the Sergeant's leads into the dungeon and watch for sealed chambers, old symbols, or anything the patrol ledgers cannot explain.

report_first_relic.Title: Report the strange relic
report_first_relic.Help Text: Bring the strange relic back to the Sergeant. He may be able to match it against the old patrol reports.

Uncertain Reports.Start Text: Still willing to look into those reports? The ledgers are here. Read them before you go down. If you find a mark you recognize, make a copy and bring it back.
Uncertain Reports.End Text: Tomas died at the threshold. Mira's marks continued beyond it. Three patrol sketches fit Triangulus, and an older record shows six positions around an empty center. Bring any matching finds to Caedmon.
Uncertain Reports.Help Text: Follow the Sergeant's leads into the dungeon and watch for sealed chambers, old symbols, or anything the patrol ledgers cannot explain.

Cry Havoc!.Start Text: Edrin recognized the pale eyes in Joffrey's bestiary. Two other patrols saw them near the sealed chamber. Hunt the Barghest and search the chamber.
Cry Havoc!.End Text: Here. The ring's yours. I'll tell the next patrol they can search that stretch again.
Cry Havoc!.Help Text: The locked door south of town leads toward the sealed chamber. Watch the eyes if it changes shape.

collecting.Title: Recover the related relics
collecting.Help Text: The first relic matches old reports of related sealed chambers. Recover each relic you find and bring proof back to the Sergeant.

The Holy Relics.Start Text: I've matched your relic against the old ledgers. The names and shapes are damaged, but the pattern is too consistent to ignore. Six reports. Six sealed chambers. Six objects that made wounded soldiers sound like priests and liars at the same time. I won't pretend I understand what they are, but the final threshold reacts to this kind of power. Recover the rest before something down there decides the pattern for us.
The Holy Relics.End Text: Six relics, six reports, and somehow the ledgers make less sense than when we started. Still, the final threshold answers to them. I don't know if they are weapons, keys, or warnings, but they are the only proof we have that the way ahead can be opened and survived.
The Holy Relics.Help Text: The relics appear tied to sealed chambers and powerful guardians. Recover each one you find; the Sergeant is comparing their markings against old patrol reports.

Ignis Equus.Start Text: Two men followed the chalk line all the way to a patch of burned boots. One kept walking. The other dragged him back. Find the horse they saw in that hall before I send anyone else through.
Ignis Equus.End Text: Both men are here. Would you tell them yourself? One still thinks he saw his friend catch fire.
Ignis Equus.Help Text: Subterfuge will not work on this steed, who sees and hears all. That and the whole 'made of fire' thing. Oh and it can fly, unreal.

Immovable Object.Start Text: Only a powerful wizard is capable of creating a golem and a truly powerful wizard must have created the Iron Golem. While we do not know who created this monstrosity, the fact is you will not be able to get to the 5th floor without taking it out.
Immovable Object.End Text: I shouldn't be surprised at this point but again you've done what was thought impossible. Choose your reward and good luck going forward, although it doesn't seem that you need much luck...
Immovable Object.Help Text: Do not let the Iron Golem get its hands on you, as it will literally crush you to oblivion.

In the Day of Our Lord.Start Text: We hatched Domingo here. The little thing used to curl up against the warm side of the incubator. We wanted a town guard. When it grew too big to handle, we put it in irons. The straps have torn clean out of the wall. I need you to find it before anyone else does.
In the Day of Our Lord.End Text: The keepers want their tag back. I'll take it to them. They ought to hear how it ended from someone who signed the order. The staffed warp point is open to you now.
In the Day of Our Lord.Help Text: The magical creature excels at, you guessed it, magic. Look out for the powerful Photon Sphere spell. The scientists will not risk opening the deeper warp until Domingo is gone.

Bring Him Home.Start Text: We received a report about a small child named Timmy who somehow made it past my guards and into the dungeon. While my men have been punished accordingly, we still need to find the boy before something bad happens to him. Locate him (he shouldn't have gone far) and bring him home to his family.
Bring Him Home.End Text: Timmy is home with his parents.
Bring Him Home.Help Text: That kid must be an expert at hide-and-seek. I have sent several sentries to find him and haven't seen a trace. I guess there is an alternate outcome...let's not think that way.

Rookie Mistake.Start Text: I need your help finding one of our new recruits. He went below before he was ready, and I let a barracks culture that praises risk convince him courage was the same thing as preparation. He has not come back. Find him, dead or alive, and bring him home.
Rookie Mistake.End Text: The recruit was buried in Silvana. His patrol clasp marks the grave.
Rookie Mistake.Help Text: I'd be surprised if he made it out of the first level of the dungeon, so I'd start by searching there.

Something to Cry About.Start Text: Oh man, I am so screwed...do you think you can help me? I let the waitress borrow my key to the tavern and the boss is gonna kill me if I don't get it back. Could you try and track her down for me and get the key back? This may be a long shot but I am desperate. People are saying she went crazy after her fiance died and she took off into the dungeon and hasn't been seen since. I know this sounds a bit heartless after what she's been through but she made her choice and now I have to pay for it. I don't have much but I can give you this potion my mom keeps on her mantle. She claims it makes her live longer but who knows whether that's true or not.
Something to Cry About.End Text: So she really did go crazy. It's sad what grief will do to a person...thanks for tracking her down but it turns out she left the tavern key in my locker before she left. Whatever this key is, it's not mine. You can keep it, maybe it'll unlock something useful. Here's that potion I promised you.
Something to Cry About.Help Text: Adventurers have told stories of hearing wailing on the second floor of the dungeon that sounds like a woman crying.

Where's the Beef?.Start Text: My wedding day is fast approaching and we are trying to save a few gold, so I am cooking the meal for the guests. If you could bring me back 12 pieces of mystery meat, I can reward you with this potion I received as a tip once.
Where's the Beef?.End Text: Thank you, thank you, thank you! You have made my special day that much easier. Please take this as a token of my appreciation.
Where's the Beef?.Help Text: The wedding guests aren't picky when it comes to the food, so any animal meat will do.

Oedipal Complex.Start Text: Legend says that Merzhin was sired from the union of a virgin and a demon, resulting in a powerful being with the cunning of a demon and the resilience of a human. The Incubus is said to be Merzhin's father, and it is rumored that he still lurks in the depths below. If you can find and defeat him, I will reward you with something that may help you on your quest.
Oedipal Complex.End Text: You have defeated the Incubus, a feat that many have attempted but few have accomplished. This creature is a powerful foe, and you should be proud of your victory. As a reward, take this pendant. It is said to make you harder to hit by magic, which may come in handy as you face the challenges ahead.
Oedipal Complex.Help Text: The Incubus is a master of illusion and manipulation, using sleep and terror to frighten his foes. Be cautious of his abilities that can drain your health and mana.

The Holy Grail of Quests.Start Text: Your strength and courage have both been tested. Now you must seek that which was lost—the Golden Chalice, a sacred vessel imbued with ancient power. It lies hidden somewhere in the depths below, guarded by trials and riddles. Many have sought it; few have found it. If you can locate this relic and bring it to me, you will have proven yourself worthy of Merzhin's defeat. The chalice will amplify your spirit and prepare you for the trials ahead.
The Holy Grail of Quests.End Text: You have found the Golden Chalice! Its holy radiance fills my spring, and I can feel the balance of power shifting in your favor. You are truly ready now. When you wish to enter the Realm of Cambion and face Merzhin, return to me. The chalice's blessing will guide you through his illusions.
The Holy Grail of Quests.Help Text: The Golden Chalice was lost in the deepest levels long ago. Speak with the travelers and keepers of knowledge throughout the dungeon—they may provide clues to its location. Search wisely.

The Wizard's Folly.Start Text: You have proven yourself worthy. Now I shall grant you passage to the Realm of Cambion, where Merzhin awaits. He is a master of illusion and deception, and the realm beyond my spring bends itself around his will. Navigate his tricks, find him in the labyrinth, and defeat him. Only then will you have my eternal gratitude. Be warned: nothing in his realm is as it seems.
The Wizard's Folly.End Text: At last, Merzhin has been vanquished! His illusions fade and his realm crumbles. You have done what I could not—freed me from his relentless torment. Take this blade, forged from the waters of my spring. It carries my blessing and will serve you well in the battles to come. May the waters guide you, champion.
The Wizard's Folly.Help Text: Nimue can send you into the Realm of Cambion from the Underground Spring. Merzhin resides deep within that shifting maze. Trust nothing you see, and be prepared for his mind games.

ask_barkeep.Help Text: Speak with the Barkeep at the Thirsty Dog about the first descent.
ask_barkeep.Progress Text: The Barkeep marks the safer descent on your map: the stairs at the north edge of the first floor.

find_descent.Help Text: Find the stairs at the north edge of the first dungeon floor.
find_descent.Completion Text: You have confirmed the first descent and can report the route to Seraphine.

A Candle for the Descent.Start Text: The old Barkeep keeps practical notes on the first descent. Ask him which route the newest adventurers are surviving, then follow his marked route before you report back to me.
A Candle for the Descent.End Text: Good. A prepared mage lives longer than a brilliant but lost one. Keep your eyes open for the stairs and do not mistake the first floor for the whole dungeon.
A Candle for the Descent.Help Text: Speak with the Barkeep at the Thirsty Dog about the first descent.

Spores in the Dark.Start Text: The first few dungeon levels conceal more than rats and rust. Bring me four Fungus Spores from the cave paths so I can finish a lantern reagent for explorers willing to seek deeper routes.
Spores in the Dark.End Text: These are fresh enough to hold their glow. Take this draught, and remember: when the first floor grows familiar, the stairs are an invitation rather than a wall.
Spores in the Dark.Help Text: Fungus Spores come from fungal growth and themed creature loot on the early dungeon floors.

The Spring's Reflection.Start Text: A reflection in my scrying glass points to an underground spring. Find the place itself and note how its water answers magic; I need proof, not another tavern rumor.
The Spring's Reflection.End Text: So the spring is real. Your observation will spare several apprentices a dangerous guess.
The Spring's Reflection.Help Text: Search the third dungeon floor for the Underground Spring.

The Unquiet Thesis.Start Text: A Lich has turned scholarship into an excuse for cruelty. End its research before its notes find their way into the wrong hands.
The Unquiet Thesis.End Text: Its work is ash, and its knowledge will remain buried. Take this elixir for the battles that still demand more from you.
The Unquiet Thesis.Help Text: Liches haunt the deepest dungeon floors and command dangerous arcane magic.

ask_griswold.Help Text: Speak with Griswold at the Blacksmith about Mara's missing crates.
ask_griswold.Progress Text: Griswold identifies the culprits: Bandits have been stripping the marked crates before they reach town.

close_the_ledger.Help Text: Defeat four Bandits and return to Mara Vale with the route cleared.
close_the_ledger.Completion Text: The marked-crate bandits have been dealt with. Return to Mara Vale.

An Honest Introduction.Start Text: Griswold knows which shipments arrive damaged before they reach my ledger. Ask him about the missing crates, then act on what you learn; call it an introduction to honest work.
An Honest Introduction.End Text: You listened, remembered, and did not embellish. Those are rarer skills than a sharp knife.
An Honest Introduction.Help Text: Speak with Griswold at the Blacksmith about Mara's missing crates.

Loose Ends.Start Text: Too many keys from the old routes have fallen into untrained hands. Recover five before an amateur opens something they cannot close.
Loose Ends.End Text: These keys will be catalogued or melted down. Either result is safer than leaving them in the dark.
Loose Ends.Help Text: Keys can be found in chests and carried by creatures on the early dungeon floors.

A Breath Between Stones.Start Text: One of my runners heard a wind where no wind should be. Find the draft on the third floor and learn whether it marks a route worth putting on a private map.
A Breath Between Stones.End Text: A hidden route is worth more than a full purse when the purses run dry. You have earned a share.
A Breath Between Stones.Help Text: Search the third dungeon floor for an unnatural draft among the cave paths.

The Iron Ledger.Start Text: The Guild's locks and tools do not replace themselves. Bring me ten pieces of Scrap Metal from the depths and I will see that you are paid for every useful ounce.
The Iron Ledger.End Text: This will keep our doors opening for the right people. Your payment is already counted.
The Iron Ledger.Help Text: Scrap Metal comes from constructs, broken equipment, and enemies that consume metal.
